title: Choose a retrieval approach
summary: Start from existing interfaces and the data model before comparing products.

sections.label: Use what is already available
sections.text: If an approved API returns the required information, record its contract and validation needs first. A database replacement is a separate architecture decision.

sections.label: Different families
sections.text: These entries illustrate different models and interfaces. They do not establish drop-in compatibility, pricing, performance or availability in your environment.

sections.label: Your existing tool
sections.text: In Factory, record your component technology and its version. A custom technology is allowed when it is absent from the list. Generic guidance remains available without a specialist compatibility claim.

confidence: Documented facts have scoped sources. Suitability for a particular project remains unverified.

catalog.applicability: Use when designing how existing information is retrieved and checked.
catalog.limits: This is design guidance. It does not connect to a service or prove that a result is correct.
